items.title: Melania Trump to bring Russian and Ukrainian representatives to White House this week
items.brief: First lady Melania Trump will bring representatives from Russia and Ukraine to the White House on Thursday, after announcing a ceasefire in the city of Oleshky last month.

items.title: Trump says US is cutting off aid to Israel at year’s end because ‘they don’t need it’
items.brief: President Donald Trump said Tuesday that the United States is cutting off $4 billion in aid to Israel at the end of the year because “they don’t need it.”

items.title: Bomb threats on flights in Europe cause disruption but no devices found
items.brief: At least four flights in Europe were subjected to bomb threats on Tuesday after one ​on Monday, forcing some to divert and an ‌airport in Poland to briefly close, although no confirmed devices were discovered.

items.title: Spanish soccer player Jesús de Miguel dies after on-pitch collision
items.brief: Soccer player Jesús de Miguel has died after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match on Monday, his club CD Tenerife has said.

items.brief: In 2021, a group of employees at OpenAI left to start a new company focused on the safe development of artificial intelligence.

items.title: US military conducts strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island in defensive operation, officials say
items.brief: The US military carried out limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island on Monday, three US officials told CNN, characterizing the action as defensive in nature and meant to protect US assets in the region.
